Claim 1 (Currently amended): A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein __each of the plurality of nodes is configured to broadcast an indicia of its own inter-node interference to other nodes in the local contention neighborhood__, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the broadcast indicia.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference comprises an indicia of transmission success between the other nodes and the second node.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on __a minimum desired throughput threshold for each particular node__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on __the first node's indicia of inter-node interference divided by an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the nodes that are interfered with by transmissions from the first node__.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the second node comprises a wireless local area network access point.

Claim 13 (Previously presented): A system comprising: a first node adapted to communicate wirelessly with a first access point, the first node configured to calculate an access attempt percentage for communications with the first access point, wherein the calculation is based at least partially on a received indicia of inter-node interference between the first node and a second node.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast __a dynamic weight associated with the second node__ to the first node.

Claim 15 (Previously presented): The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to calculate its access attempt percentage based on a dynamic weight of the first node, wherein the dynamic weight of the first node is based on a transmission success rate between the first node and the first access point.

Claim 16 (Previously presented): The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to calculate its access attempt percentage based on a dynamic weight broadcast by the second node, wherein the dynamic weight of the second node is based on a transmission success rate of the second node.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and __the first node's transmissions interfere with communication between the second node and the second access point__.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to calculate the access attempt percentage based at least partially on the transmission success rate between the first node and the first access point.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to communicate with the first access point using __a wireless local area network protocol__.

Claim 20 (Previously presented): The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to recalculate the access attempt percentage after a predetermined number of slots.
